text: A unified governance framework is hard to establish in the federated model because each participating entity maintains its own AI systems and datasets, producing variation in standards, protocols, and formats.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4796714
abstract: In a federated AI model, different entities or organizations maintain their own AI systems and datasets. This can lead to variations in standards, protocols, and formats used, making it difficult to establish a unified governance framework.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to federated AI architectures with independent participants
standardization is presupposed by interoperability and ethical practice
